name: GH Release
description: Github Action for creating Github Releases

body.description: Note-worthy description of changes in release

body_path.description: Path to load note-worthy description of changes in release from

name.description: Gives the release a custom name. Defaults to tag name

tag_name.description: Gives a tag name. Defaults to github.ref_name

draft.description: Creates a draft release. Defaults to false

prerelease.description: Identify the release as a prerelease. Defaults to false

preserve_order.description: Preserver the order of the artifacts when uploading

files.description: Newline-delimited list of path globs for asset files to upload

working_directory.description: Base directory to resolve 'files' globs against (defaults to job working-directory)

overwrite_files.description: Overwrite existing files with the same name. Defaults to true

fail_on_unmatched_files.description: Fails if any of the `files` globs match nothing. Defaults to false

repository.description: Repository to make releases against, in <owner>/<repo> format

token.description: Authorized secret GitHub Personal Access Token. Defaults to github.token

target_commitish.description: Commitish value that determines where the Git tag is created from. Can be any branch or commit SHA.

discussion_category_name.description: If specified, a discussion of the specified category is created and linked to the release. The value must be a category that already exists in the repository. I

generate_release_notes.description: Whether to automatically generate the name and body for this release. If name is specified, the specified name will be used; otherwise, a name will be automatic

append_body.description: Append to existing body instead of overwriting it. Default is false.

make_latest.description: Specifies whether this release should be set as the latest release for the repository. Drafts and prereleases cannot be set as latest. Can be `true`, `false`, o
